autonomous_sales.action_optimize_desc: Evaluates all email variations, disables poor performers, promotes winners, and optionally sends a batch of test emails. You can run this as often as you like.
autonomous_sales.action_score_desc: Analyzes your leads and ranks them by how likely they are to become customers. Higher-scoring leads get contacted first. Run this after importing new leads.
autonomous_sales.custom_variation_desc: Add your own subject line idea. The system will test it against the others and automatically determine if it performs well. Use {{first_name}} and {{company_name}} as placeholders.
autonomous_sales.custom_variation_summary: Add a custom subject line variation

health.needs_variations: The system needs at least %min% email variations to optimize effectively. Click "Set up default variations" below.
health.off_desc: The sales automation system is currently disabled. Turn it on to start optimizing outreach.
health.paused_desc: Email performance has dropped below the safety threshold. The system has automatically paused non-essential sends to protect your sender reputation. Only proven email variations are being used.
health.quarantined_variations: %count% email variation(s) were automatically disabled due to poor performance.
health.ready_desc: The system is set up but has not sent any emails yet. Run an optimization cycle to begin testing.
health.running_desc: The system is actively optimizing your outreach emails. It automatically tests different subject lines and templates, and sends more traffic to the best performers.

autonomous_sales.how_it_works_step1_desc: The system creates multiple versions of your outreach emails (different subject lines, templates, and send times) and sends each version to a small group of prospects.
autonomous_sales.how_it_works_step2_desc: It tracks opens, clicks, and replies for each variation. Over time, it builds a statistical model of what works best for different types of prospects.
autonomous_sales.how_it_works_step3_desc: Winners get more traffic automatically. Losers get phased out. The system always keeps a baseline variation as a safety net and automatically pauses if overall performance drops.
autonomous_sales.no_arms_hint: Create arms via the Autonomous Sales API to start learning.
autonomous_sales.performance_description: These numbers update automatically as the system sends emails and tracks results.
autonomous_sales.quick_optimize_desc: Run a preview cycle to evaluate your email variations. No emails are sent — it just checks what would happen.
autonomous_sales.quick_optimize_hint: For advanced options like live sends and batch sizes, use the Optimization tab.
autonomous_sales.quick_score_desc: Re-rank your leads by purchase likelihood so the system contacts the best prospects first.
autonomous_sales.safety_auto_mode_desc: If the overall bounce/unsubscribe rate exceeds 35%, the system automatically stops all experimental sends and only uses proven variations until performance recovers.
autonomous_sales.safety_business_hours_desc: Emails are only sent during business hours (9 AM – 4 PM) in the recipient's local timezone, inferred from their company location. Weekends are excluded.
autonomous_sales.safety_campaign_bridge_desc: Engagement events from marketing campaigns are automatically forwarded to the ML optimizer, so the system learns from all email interactions — not just automated ones.
autonomous_sales.safety_cross_module_limits_desc: Send limits count emails from both Email Campaigns and Sales Automation combined. A prospect in a drip sequence and automated outreach won't receive more than 2 emails per week or 5 per month total.
autonomous_sales.safety_full_desc: These protections run automatically to keep your sender reputation safe and ensure prospects are not over-contacted.
autonomous_sales.safety_instant_kill_desc: Any email variation with a negative response rate above 50% is immediately disabled and will never be used again.
autonomous_sales.safety_quality_checks_desc: Every email is checked for spam triggers, missing personalization, excessive punctuation, and other quality issues before sending. Emails that fail are blocked.
autonomous_sales.safety_shared_suppression_desc: Contacts who unsubscribe from marketing campaigns are automatically blocked from receiving automated outreach, and vice versa. One unsubscribe stops all email modules.
autonomous_sales.safety_unified_timeline_desc: Every outbound email and engagement event (open, click, reply) is recorded on the contact's CRM Activity timeline alongside campaign emails, calls, and meetings — giving sales reps complete visibility.
autonomous_sales.setup_default_variations_desc: Creates 4 proven subject line styles (direct question, value proposition, capability focus, cost focus). The system tests all of them and automatically uses the best ones more often.
autonomous_sales.setup_description: Complete these steps to get your sales automation running. Each step builds on the previous one.
autonomous_sales.setup_initialize_desc: Loads email templates, creates initial variations, and imports competitor data. Only needs to be done once.
autonomous_sales.subtitle: Live Thompson Sampling performance across email experiments.
